findings.title: browser storage read reaches visitor IP on page load (Google Fonts) in 0 hops
findings.detail: Loading fonts from Google sends each visitor IP address to Google before any consent banner appears. German courts have already ruled against this; self-hosting the font files removes the issue entirely.
